notes: Reference table for the Dictionarry V2-style FR conversion.
Custom format names are Dictionarry-shaped with FR at the beginning.
FORWARD is treated as FW, but both regex patterns are linked where useful.
Quality tiers keep only the best tier per team to avoid double tier scores.
LQ remains handled by the banned/LQ custom formats.
FR tier custom formats scored above 600000 require the HEVC regex, which matches h265, x265 and HEVC.
Shared technical profile scores are realigned with Dictionarry V2 without importing US release-group tiers.
The common technical layer includes the current Dictionarry CAM, Extras, 3D, Full Disc, HDR, Dolby Vision, SDR and missing-x265 conditions.

Apple TV and Apple TV+ are detected separately; HBO and Discovery+ are available as zero-score streaming-service formats, while the 2160p platform scores follow the current Dictionarry split between Radarr and Sonarr.
High-score FR tiers have required source gates in ops/8 so WEB and Bluray tiers cannot stack on the same release.

2160p Efficient WEB composite tiers are removed in ops/17 to align with Dictionarry V2: 2160p WEB releases score through 2160p WEB-DL (Efficient/Balanced), while trusted FR groups keep premium tiers on Bluray HEVC.
FR WEB tiers with optional WEB-DL/WEBRip source conditions are hardened in ops/18: WEB source must be present, and release-group tier matching is no longer satisfied by source alone.
FR 720p/1080p Quality tiers are hardened in ops/19: Bluray/WEBRip source must be present, and source alone no longer satisfies the tier.
FR Scene Tier is capped in high-ceiling Remux/2160p profiles by ops/10 because the source score already sits near the ceiling.
FR 1080p Quality tiers are capped in Quality/Remux profiles by ops/11 to remain below the ceiling with 1080p WEB-DL source scoring.
FR 2160p Quality tiers require HEVC in ops/16 so rare 2160p h264 releases keep normal source scoring instead of taking a high 2160p team-tier score.
2160p Compact FR is added in ops/20 as a 4KLight profile using the same compact teams as 1080p Compact FR, with 4KLight first, 1080p Efficient as the main fallback, then 1080p Compact below it.
HDLight and 4KLight title markers are added in ops/21 and banned in Quality profiles so Quality does not accept light encodes.
HDLight and 4KLight receive a light -50000 penalty in Balanced and Efficient profiles: allowed, but not prioritized.

Generic non-tier Compact Light source CFs are added in ops/21: 4KLight Bluray/WEBRip for 2160p Compact FR and HDLight Bluray/WEBRip for 1080p Compact FR. Compact tier teams are excluded so these generic CFs do not double-score tiered groups.
2160p WEBRip is added in ops/22 by copying 4KLight WEBRip (Compact) before removing the 4KLight marker; then 4KLight WEBRip (Compact) is widened from strict WEBRip source to broad WEB title matching.
IMAX follows HDR10+ scoring: 2000 where HDR10+ is rewarded, 0 where HDR10+ is banned, so IMAX is never itself a ban condition.

FR Scene Tier is kept profile-specific: 127000 in 1080p Quality profiles, 15000 in 1080p Compact FR, 4000 in 2160p Compact FR and other high-ceiling 2160p/Remux profiles, and 126000 immediately below the dedicated tiers in Anime profiles.
UHD Bluray is adapted for French usage in ops/21: it now requires 2160p instead of 1080p, and no longer requires an explicit HDR marker.

2160p Efficient FR now uses FR 2160p Efficient WEB h265 and FR 2160p Efficient Bluray h265 as source passes without release-group conditions; teams are scored separately through the reusable FR WEB/Bluray tiers.
2160p WEB-DL (Efficient/Balanced) replaces Dictionarry's US high-trust exclusions with FR Efficient team exclusions: TyHD, THESYNDICATE, CHiLL, SUPPLY, FW/FORWARD and TFA.
2160p Balanced FR uses 2160p WEB-DL (Efficient/Balanced) at 720000 instead of UHD Bluray at 840000.
Release-group checks are group-scoped in Profilarr; title words such as Lion in a movie title must not be interpreted as LQ group matches.
FR 2160p Balanced uses Tier 1 naming, not Tier 3, because the profile has one FR balanced tier and it replaces the Dictionarry hallowed/BHDStudio-style pass.
The 1080p and 2160p Compact tier names are normalized in ops/21 by removing Movie/TV from the final CF names, then reinserted for both Radarr and Sonarr.

2160p Compact FR keeps 1080p Efficient fallback below all 4KLight paths: 1080p source Efficient is 840000 and validated 1080p HEVC team tiers are lightweight 50000 bonuses, so the combined 890000 remains below 4KLight WEBRip at 900000.
Historical FR source tiers are rebuilt without Global or Movie/TV splits: WEB Top, WEB, Bluray, UHD Bluray, Light, DVD and Unknown are the reusable source buckets.
1080p Balanced FR is normalized in ops/22: reusable FR WEB tiers add small team bonuses, while the obsolete FR 1080p Balanced composite CF is removed.

French Missing (INTL) no longer treats a known French team as proof of French language by itself. A team only prevents the INTL missing-French penalty when combined with MULTi or MultiSub, or when the title has an explicit French marker. Its optional French Except and Original Except language conditions form an OR group; only monolingual French-original metadata prevents the penalty without a trusted title marker.

French Original requires both French Except and Original Except with Negate and Required: only monolingual French metadata on French-original content matches. MULTi and explicit VOF/VOQ markers remain excluded and are handled by their dedicated custom formats to prevent double matching.

language_policy.classic_profiles: MULTi, French Original and French Original Marker are neutral at 0, VF is slightly penalized, VOSTFR is strongly penalized, VFQ and missing French are rejected.
language_policy.anime_profiles: Anime 1080p FR uses MULTi/French Original > VOSTFR > VF on the 1,000,000-point scale. Anime 1080p VOSTFR FR shares the same technical and team scores but strictly rejects every non-VOSTFR language path.
language_policy.french_original: French Original neutralizes the need for MULTi on native French or Quebec content, so a French-original release is not punished for not carrying a separate MULTi/VF tag.
language_policy.french_original_marker: VOF and VOQ are treated as French Original markers. They prevent French Missing and VF/VFQ/VOSTFR penalties because they describe the original francophone version rather than an unwanted dub.
language_policy.intl_trackers: For international trackers, a French release group alone is not enough to prove French audio or subtitles. French Missing (INTL) is prevented by monolingual French-original metadata, by explicit French markers, by MULTi + known French team, by MultiSub + known French team, or by VF/VOSTFR/VFQ/VOF/VOQ markers. Explicit MULTi markers may contain up to six intermediary language codes or words, covering forms such as MULTI.WITH.TRUEFRENCH, MULTI.VO.VFF and MULTI.EN.ES.VFF.
language_policy.intl_dynamic_team_markers: French MULTi + Team FR Marker (INTL) and French MultiSub + Team FR Marker (INTL) are regenerated from all regexes tagged French + Release Group, so newly added French teams are automatically covered.

tier_policy.quality_and_remux: Quality and Remux tiers follow the TRaSH FR tier source as directly as possible, with FR Global teams folded down where they are useful.
tier_policy.balanced: Balanced is intentionally narrow: FW/FORWARD and SUPPLY are the main trusted 2160p/1080p stable groups, with TFA as the lower balanced fallback where applicable.
tier_policy.compact: Compact is reserved for HDLight and 4KLight-style encode groups. Final 1080p/2160p Compact CF names are generic across Radarr and Sonarr, with Movie/TV removed after migration.
tier_policy.efficient: Efficient is limited to validated HEVC groups: TyHD, THESYNDICATE, CHiLL, SUPPLY, FW/FORWARD and TFA.
tier_policy.scene: FR Scene Tier is trusted but capped depending on profile ceiling: 127000 in 1080p Quality, 126000 below all dedicated Anime tiers, 15000 in 1080p Compact FR, and 4000 in high-ceiling Remux/2160p profiles.
tier_policy.anime: Both Anime profiles copy the effective 1080p Quality FR technical matrix for sources, resolutions, audio, streaming services, editions and compatibility bans. HEVC/x265 and HDR/Dolby Vision remain neutral because they are valid anime encodes.

2160p_compact_fr.goal: Target 4KLight releases first, then accept 1080p Efficient fallback, then 1080p Compact fallback below it.
2160p_compact_fr.primary_match: 2160p Compact tiers require 2160p + Bluray or WEBRip + x265 + a compact release group. WEB tiers require WEBRip only; 2160p WEB-DL is banned in this profile.
2160p_compact_fr.score_order: Tier 1 4KLight Bluray/WEBRip is 970000, Tier 2 4KLight Bluray/WEBRip is 969000, generic 4KLight Bluray is 940000, generic 4KLight WEBRip is 900000, validated 1080p Efficient fallback is 890000 after source + tier bonus, generic 2160p WEBRip is 880000, 1080p Compact tiers are 830000/829000, and generic 1080p WEBRip Compact fallback is 820000.
2160p_compact_fr.ceiling_check: The expected top score for a MULTi DV/HDR10 EAC3 7.1 QTZ 4KLight release stays below the 1,000,000 ceiling, and 1080p Efficient source + tier cannot exceed the 4KLight Compact tiers.

technical_alignment.source_gates: High-score FR tiers use required source gates so a WEB release cannot also satisfy a Bluray tier, and source alone cannot satisfy a release-group tier.
technical_alignment.hevc_gates: FR tiers scored above 600000 require HEVC/x265 where needed, mirroring Dictionarry V2's high-trust tier behavior without importing US teams.
technical_alignment.2160p_efficient: 2160p Efficient follows Dictionarry V2's WEB model: generic 2160p WEB-DL scores through the technical CF, while premium FR team tiers stay on Bluray HEVC.
technical_alignment.release_group_scope: Release-group regexes are meant to match the release group field, not the movie title. This matters for short group names such as LION.

historical_source_tiers.scope: These tiers replace the old TRaSH-shaped Global/Movie/TV custom formats for reusable French source buckets. Movie/TV is removed from names, but UHD Bluray remains separate from standard Bluray.
historical_source_tiers.web_top: FW/FORWARD, CHiLL, TyHD, TFA and THESYNDICATE are removed from normal WEB Tier 1 and live in FR WEB Top Tier only.
historical_source_tiers.source_policy: WEB tiers require a WEB title marker; Bluray tiers require a Bluray source; UHD Bluray tiers require 2160p + Bluray and keep the historical Not Remux / Not SDR gates; Light, DVD and Unknown stay release-group based.
historical_source_tiers.deleted: HYPERION is removed from every functional tier/tag and its regex is neutralized because it releases games, not video. The regex row is kept only to avoid Profilarr FK compilation failures.
